headline: Full-campaign difficulty review identifies late-stage bottlenecks

changes.title: Summarize 1,000 campaign stages from actual test evidence
changes.detail: Added a nonblocking balance-risk reviewer that checks the full diagnostic evidence, reports chapter-by-chapter greedy-bot outcomes, and highlights consecutive zero-win stretches without claiming human completion rates or changing stages.

changes.title: Preserve detailed difficulty signals in CI
changes.detail: The optional GitHub Actions diagnostics now archive a verified balance-risk JSON report and display the measured difficulty patterns separately from the signed release's functional gates.

changes.title: Test the risk report without blocking releases
changes.detail: Added synthetic full-campaign aggregation checks and classified the reviewer test as report-only, so missing evidence is visible without treating hard levels or cosmetic observations as release-blocking gameplay defects.
